name: 4th Of July
overview: Scripture calls believers to a decisive commitment to serve the LORD, as Joshua 24:15 declares the choice between following God or other gods. The blessing of a nation is directly tied to its acknowledgment of God as its ruler and protector, as Psalms 33:12 affirms. Proverbs 21:1 reminds us that God sovereignly directs the hearts of leaders, underscoring His control over earthly governance. Yet, the warnings in Hosea 8:1 and Job 9:24 reveal the consequences of covenant unfaithfulness and the presence of wickedness in the world, urging vigilance and faithfulness to God's law. Mark 13:1 points to the temporal nature of earthly structures, inviting believers to focus on God's eternal kingdom rather than human accomplishments.
